authority: Dated planning snapshot. Current source, GitHub state, exact-SHA checks, and independent evidence override this register.

items.title: Published v0.3.0 community release
items.acceptance: Published version and exact-SHA release gates are preserved; later commits require their own verification.
items.next_step: Preserve evidence without re-releasing completed work.

items.title: Project persistence, handoff, and restart recovery
items.acceptance: Project-scoped state and bounded recovery are implemented with focused tests.
items.next_step: Extend, not rebuild, the existing persistence engine.

items.title: Recorded state is not completed work (PR #169)
items.acceptance: Merged with exact-head CI; recorded state remains distinct from externally verified completion.
items.next_step: Preserve neutral Recorded labels; reopen only if a regression is observed.

items.title: Project State Reconciler read-only v1
items.acceptance: An opt-in bounded preview differentiates persisted records and unknown external results without changing private state.
items.next_step: Preserve the metadata-only, bounded API invariants; keep the Projects-screen preview and conflict classification as separate future increments.

items.title: Task/Decision/Outcome lifecycle provenance
items.acceptance: Explicit proof-aware lifecycle, version conflicts and user approvals are described before schema changes.
items.next_step: Design lifecycle state transitions and failure tests.
items.design_goal: RFC for lifecycle version, proof scope and privacy

items.title: Provider-neutral core and project isolation
items.acceptance: Adapter and project boundaries are backed by source and regression suites.
items.next_step: Preserve existing boundaries; real provider use has a separate gate.

items.title: Real provider switching with persisted project state
items.acceptance: An observed first-hand provider switch retains task and conversation state after restart.
items.next_step: Run operator-controlled credentialed/local-provider acceptance with redacted outcome.
items.proof_needed: Exact SHA, provider identities, restart, state/trace and failure result

items.title: Unified Settings and first-run information architecture
items.acceptance: Accessible standard/advanced grouping for privacy, services, budget, data and diagnostics.
items.next_step: Write screen and consent/secret handling RFC before UI changes.
items.design_goal: Interaction states, permissions and first-run usability test

items.title: Budget reservation and usage safety
items.acceptance: Deterministic tests cover reservations, settlement, hard stops and concurrent races.
items.next_step: Keep regression coverage; invoices need independent evidence.

items.title: MCP side-effect confirmation and send-scope receipt
items.acceptance: Deterministic tests prove bounded consent, actor/tool binding and redaction.
items.next_step: Do not weaken permission or replay boundaries.

items.title: Interrupted execution and unknown side-effect safety
items.acceptance: Run state and no-auto-retry semantics have deterministic tests.
items.next_step: Keep external provider failures distinct from fixture coverage.

items.title: Backup, migration, restore and user data portability
items.acceptance: Backup/restore safety code exists; real installed upgrade is not proved by it.
items.next_step: Advance integration safety checks; preserve all private records.

items.title: Real Windows distribution and rollback acceptance
items.acceptance: Disposable install, update and rollback have dated integrity results.
items.next_step: Obtain real operator environment and rollback verification without deleting user data.
items.proof_needed: Windows version, package hash, backup and rollback run

items.title: Signing identity and signed Windows artifacts
items.acceptance: Owner-custodied signing identity and independent signature evidence exist.
items.next_step: Retain unsigned limitation until owner supplies authorized custody.
items.proof_needed: Owner-provided cert and verified signed artifact

items.title: Physical mobile PWA and assistive-tech verification
items.acceptance: Physical HTTPS iOS/Android and real screen-reader behavior is observed.
items.next_step: Request consented actual-device test; no emulation substitution.
items.proof_needed: OS, device, HTTPS origin, focus, offline and recovery results

items.title: v0.4 release-candidate gate and stable handoff
items.acceptance: Exact-SHA checks, soak, review and explicit external limitations meet published gate.
items.next_step: Finish candidate verification; do not automatically merge, tag or release.

items.title: Seven-to-fourteen-day daily dogfooding
items.acceptance: Dated continuous real operator receipts pass the protocol.
items.next_step: Collect day-by-day results; time elapsed alone is insufficient.
items.proof_needed: Seven or fourteen dated real runs with exact version

items.title: Independent first-use and real-workflow evidence
items.acceptance: Independent testers report actual attempts, including failures, and reproducible environment.
items.next_step: Continue Issues #7 and #55; do not manufacture adoption.
items.proof_needed: Real user OS/SHA/workflow/result and optional re-test

items.title: Independent Windows and macOS/Linux clean installs
items.acceptance: Independent no-key setup results on requested platforms exist.
items.next_step: Continue Issues #15 and #56 and fix reproduced friction.
items.proof_needed: Dated fresh installs with exact SHA and results

items.title: Next.js 16.4.5 security patch review
items.acceptance: Review exact-head tests and security delta before deciding merger.
items.next_step: Prioritize #168 without automatic merge.

items.title: Python 3.15-slim major compatibility
items.acceptance: Supported runtimes and dependencies demonstrate compatibility before major upgrade.
items.next_step: Review #166 as a compatibility project, not an automatic patch.

items.title: vinext and Cloudflare packages alignment
items.acceptance: Coherent dependency set and lockfile pass hosted build and relevant checks.
items.next_step: Review #162/#163 together without fragmentary upgrades.

items.title: UI icons and Node type dependency maintenance
items.acceptance: Relevant frontend checks pass on compatible versions.
items.next_step: Review #159/#161 only for warranted benefit.

items.title: Cross-client project-state handoff acceptance
items.acceptance: Two actual clients reproduce evidence-sensitive resume on one non-sensitive fixture.
items.next_step: Compare two genuine clients using synthetic handoff; keep unpublished working materials private.
items.proof_needed: Observed cross-client resume outcomes and independent non-sensitive tester results

items.title: End-to-end speech input and spoken response
items.acceptance: Speech/transcript/restart/interrupt and permissions behavior has an accepted contract.
items.next_step: Design small voice acceptance and cancellation matrix.
items.design_goal: Voice capture, consent, interruption, persistence and safety RFC

items.title: Codex/Research project plugins
items.acceptance: Plugins use shared Project contracts without domain fields in core.
items.next_step: Specify one reference plugin and prove isolation.

items.title: Tasks, Calendar, Journal, Reading and daily workflow
items.acceptance: A user-validated need and non-overlap with existing Project Tasks justify each module.
items.next_step: Prioritize a single need after real external usage evidence.
items.design_goal: Usability, persistence, scope and privacy RFC

items.title: Gemini and new model provider adapters
items.acceptance: Provider conformance and real demand justify post-v0.4 scope.
items.next_step: No untested new provider in v0.4 candidate.
items.review_trigger: Core RC accepted plus real demand and fault contract

items.title: Managed-cloud account, billing and device sync
items.acceptance: Identity, tenant isolation, deletion, finance and support are operationally ready.
items.next_step: Maintain fail-closed cloud contract.

items.title: Agent swarms, marketplace and unrelated integrations
items.acceptance: A separate user-problem/permission design demonstrates value and manageable cost.
items.next_step: Do not increase v0.4 scope to inflate feature count.
items.review_trigger: Explicit user evidence and separate approved proposal

items.title: Maintainer and open-source application evidence
items.acceptance: Claims cite real releases, contributor actions and adoption; no assumed approval.
items.next_step: Keep public ledger accurate; check application result only through actual decision evidence.

items.title: Upstream FastMCP contribution and related issue
items.acceptance: Upstream #4881 is merged and #4854 closed; no vendor adoption assumed.
items.next_step: Monitor only meaningful regression or follow-up.

items.title: First-run Doctor diagnostic comprehension
items.acceptance: User can interpret a redacted failure and choose a safe, reversible next step.
items.next_step: Build targeted diagnostic UX/regression without exposing private state.
